attempted_claim: Let G be the Chvatal graph, i.e. up to isomorphism the smallest triangle-free 4-regular 4-chromatic graph (12 vertices, 24 edges). Let k be any field, R=k[x_v : v in V(G)], and I=I(G) its edge ideal, with symbolic powers I^{(s)} defined by intersecting s-th powers of minimal primes (minimal vertex covers). Using combinatorial Rees-algebra containment data together with Waldschmidt-constant lower and upper bounds, determine the exact Waldschmidt constant \hat{\alpha}(I) and the exact resurgence \rho(I)=sup{m/r : I^{(m)} not subset I^r}, and on that basis decide whether the boundary containment I^{(5)} subset I^3 holds or fails, uniformly over all m,r>=1. A complete answer proves the exact constants (or bounds tight enough to force the stated pair) and either gives a Rees/cover proof of I^{(5)} subset I^3 or exhibits an explicit monomial in I^{(5)}\I^3 with membership and non-membership certificates.
claim_type: exact Waldschmidt, resurgence and boundary containment decision
decisive_failure: Evidence is fragmentary and uncertified: the rational-dual verification log, the alpha(m) table, and the degree-8 containment log are not preserved as artifacts; the exhaustive I^(5) versus I^3 enumeration never completed; and no resurgence certificate exists. No complete auditable result can be packaged at budget expiry.
